description: Time selection criteria parameter class codes

codes.name: Fri
codes.description: An indicator that Friday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.  OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.name: Mon
codes.description: An indicator that Monday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.  OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.name: Prefend
codes.description: The preferred end time for the appointment request, service or resource.  Any legal time specification in the format HHMM, using 24-hour clock notation

codes.name: Prefstart
codes.description: The preferred start time for the appointment request, service or resource.   Any legal time specification in the format HHMM, using 24-hour clock notation

codes.name: Sat
codes.description: An indicator that Saturday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.  OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.name: Sun
codes.description: An indicator that Sunday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.  OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.name: Thu
codes.description: An indicator that Thursday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.  OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.name: Tue
codes.description: An indicator that Tuesday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.  OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.name: Wed
codes.description: An indicator that Wednesday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur. OK = Preferred appointment day; NO = Day is not preferred

codes.description: Flat-rate.  Apply the entire price to this interval, do not pro-rate the price if the full interval has not occurred/been consumed

codes.name: P
codes.description: Pro-rate.  Apply this price to this interval, pro-rated by whatever portion of the interval has occurred/been consumed

codes.name: Q<integer>J<day#>
codes.description: repeats on a particular day of the week, from the French jour (day).  If <integer> is missing, the repeat rate is assumed to be 1.  Day numbers are counted from 1=Monday to 7=Sunday.  So Q2J2 means every second Tuesday; Q1J6 means every Saturday.
